_README: Binary human labels for judge calibration. faithful: is every claim supported by the retrieved evidence? relevant: does the response address the question (a correct abstention on an unanswerable question IS relevant; an abstention on an answerable one is NOT). faithful is omitted where the system abstained, because an abstention makes no claims.
_annotator: assistant (Claude) reading each answer against its evidence -- NOT an independent human annotator. This is a real methodological limitation: the labels and the system under test were produced by related processes, so agreement is optimistically biased. Re-label with an independent annotator before citing kappa externally.
